layman_headline: Market fear is near extreme levels — patience is the smartest play right now.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is gripped by deep fear, with the Fear and Greed Index at 25 and worsening daily. Bitcoin is holding steady around $64K with a small bounce today, but altcoins are generally struggling with high BTC dominance squeezing them. The best swing candidates are either already overbought after big runs (BTW up 57% in a week), in confirmed downtrends (MON, ZRO), or lack enough data to build conviction. None present a clean risk-reward setup worth entering right now.
layman_action: Stay in cash and wait. The fear levels suggest the market hasn't found a bottom yet, and rushing into weak setups during extreme fear is how losses happen. Watch for a fear capitulation event or a clear technical reversal before committing capital.
expert_reasoning: Per validated Rule #3, when Fear and Greed is at 25 or below, the short-term outlook is genuinely ambiguous and the safest call is HOLD. Per Rule #7, early evidence suggests BTC may drift down 1-4% more at these fear levels. Reviewing candidates: BTW is overbought (RSI 69) after a 57% weekly run with terrible risk/reward (0.29x) — classic chase setup. ZRO has the best RSI signal (30, oversold) which is my most reliable indicator (71% win rate), but the chart is bearish (-0.70 bias), price is below all MAs, and BTC dominance at 56.5% actively punishes altcoins. LDO dropped 21.6% but has zero chart data — can't define stop-loss or targets. MON is in a downtrend with bearish structure. WLD has decent R/R (2.41x) but below all MAs with bearish structure. PUMP and USDG are non-starters. No candidate combines oversold conditions with bullish chart structure and a clear catalyst.

watch_list: Fear and Greed Index — watch for a drop below 20 (capitulation signal) or recovery above 30 (stabilization)
ZRO price action at $0.70 support — if it holds and RSI stays oversold, a bounce trade becomes viable
BTC behavior around $64K — a confirmed break above with volume could shift the macro picture bullish
market_context: The crypto market is in an Extreme Fear zone (25/100, worsening) with BTC dominance high at 56.5%, signaling a risk-off environment that punishes altcoins. Mixed headlines — institutional tokenization progress (BlackRock) offset by ETF closures, exploit concerns, and fading regulatory momentum.
context_banner: Extreme Fear at 25 with worsening trend and high BTC dominance — no swing candidates meet the bar for entry; capital preservation is the priority.

key_signals.description: Fear and Greed Index at 25 (Extreme Fear), down from 28 yesterday with weekly average of 27 — per validated Rule #3, this level demands a HOLD rather than forced entry.
ZRO RSI at 30 (oversold) is the strongest technical signal available and historically reliable (71% win rate), but conflicting bearish chart structure (-0.70) prevents acting on it alone.
First US spot BTC ETF closing due to dwindling inflows signals cooling institutional demand, a bearish macro signal for the entire market.
CLARITY crypto legislation passage odds sinking to 27% as key government officials depart — removes a potential bullish catalyst and adds regulatory uncertainty.
US yen intervention warning puts Bitcoin and risk assets on notice for liquidity disruptions, adding another reason to stay sidelined.
